newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady on selective trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady on selective trade.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates held steady on Monday amid selective buying by spinners and dealers predicted the prices to fall within the next few sessions.
The spinners are selective as they beleive the prices will fall owing to a buildup of about two million 375-lb bales of unsold stocks at ginneries, the dealers said.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was traded at 2,375 rupees ($59.05) per maund (37.32 kg) and the MHN-93 at 2,575 rupees per maund, dealers said.
